instructions: The second phase starts after the four fighters are defeated. A red demon (Naraasimha) and a Lalafell named Mumuepo the Beholden show up. Yhe tank should pick up both of them. Kill Mumoepo first because he casts more and chains players in place before starting a massive AoE with a slow cast bar (Thal's Fury). The remaining unchained players needs to save them by finding the "Thal's Scepter" interactive object in the AoE to unchain their party members before the cast finishes so the chained players can escape, or they will take high damage. Once Mumoepo goes down, the rest of the fight is unremarkable. The red demon thing has a rear tail swipe, so keep that in mind if you're melee, and ranged will have to deal with a targeted AoE circle randomly at their location.
